verdict.rationale: Docs reference a 'setting up' guide that walks through verifying an email/domain identity before you can send (docs-34, docs-21), and confirm SES supports SDKs/SMTP for various languages (docs-2, docs-19), but no evidence pack item shows an actual copy-paste code quickstart for a specific language. Moreover, the required extra steps (identity verification, sandbox restrictions, and a separate production-access request before you can email arbitrary recipients — docs-13, docs-14, docs-41) mean the path from signup to first delivered email is not literally 'minutes' and involves hidden gating, and community reports (comm-6, comm-18) describe early friction like emails landing in spam due to default config issues. missing for 10: actual copy-paste quickstart code samples per language, confirmation of a fast unblocked signup-to-send flow, and independent hands-on confirmation that setup is quick and complete.
